questions.q: In an instance type name like c6g.xlarge, what does the "c" tell you?
options: The instance is the cheapest size available
The hardware is compute-optimized — a high vCPU-to-memory ratio
The instance has no network connectivity by default
The instance can only run containerized workloads
questions.explain: The family letter is a hardware promise; "c" means compute-optimized, with more processing power per GB of RAM than a general-purpose type.

questions.q: What are CPU credits, and which family relies on them?
options: A measurement of disk I/O performance on M-series instances
A billing discount applied to any instance type after 12 months of use
A security feature that limits which users can stop an instance
T-series credits that accumulate while idle and get spent to burst above baseline CPU
questions.explain: T-series instances get baseline CPU performance plus accumulated credits they can spend to burst above baseline for short periods — ideal for low, spiky load.

questions.q: Which family is the right default for a steady production application server with no special hardware pressure?
options: M-series
R-series
T-series
There is no default — always pick the cheapest option
questions.explain: M-series offers a balanced, consistent CPU-to-memory ratio with no bursting behavior, making it the standard choice for steady production workloads.

questions.q: A nightly job does heavy video transcoding that saturates the CPU for hours. Which family fits best?
options: T-series, because it's the cheapest option available
C-series, because it's compute-optimized for CPU-bound workloads
Family choice doesn't matter for batch jobs
R-series, because transcoding is a memory-bound workload
questions.explain: Sustained, CPU-bound work like transcoding fits C-series — a T-series instance would exhaust its CPU credits and get throttled back to baseline.

questions.q: What does aws ec2 describe-instance-types let you verify before committing to a type?
options: The real vCPU and memory specs for that instance type
The current AWS bill for the account
Which AMI was used to launch a specific instance
Whether a security group allows inbound SSH traffic
questions.explain: describe-instance-types returns the real, current hardware specs for any instance type, which is more reliable than memorizing numbers.
